changelog: - **Gates that branch and reach one capped Pool by two paths no longer lose resource.** When a Gate (or a Converter fed from Pools) split into Gates that led to the same capped Pool, each branch counted the Pool's whole free space, so more was taken than the Pool could hold; the Gates below could not deliver it, and the amount disappeared with only a "held" notice in the run bar. The first router now takes only what the shared Pool can hold across all its paths, however deep the branches go. Separately, an amount passed down a chain of Gates now reserves room in its Pool once, not once per Gate, so another connection into that Pool is no longer shut out of room that is really free. A saved model with these shapes moves different amounts from before; none of the bundled examples changes.
